title: Slot-ID: Identity-Preserving Video Generation from Reference Videos via Slot-Based Temporal Identity Encoding
abstract: arXiv:2601.01352v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Human identity-preserving text-to-video generation remains challenging under large changes in viewpoint, facial expression, illumination, and motion. Existing methods condition the generator on a single reference portrait, but a static image cannot capture how identity-bearing cues evolve across views and expressions, leading to face deformation, pose locking, identity drift, or over-smoothed faces. We observe that a short reference clip naturally provides richer temporal and multi-view identity cues than any single image, motivating a video-referential formulation. This richer signal, however, introduces a new challenge: identity evidence is distributed across many frames and must be distilled into a compact, stable representation under a limited token budget. translated_title: Slot-ID：基于槽位时序身份编码、从参考视频生成身份保持视频的方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2601.01352v2 公告类型：replace-cross 摘要：在视角、面部表情、光照和运动发生大幅变化的情况下，保持人类身份的文本到视频生成仍然极具挑战性。现有方法将生成器条件化于单张参考肖像，但静态图像无法捕捉身份相关线索如何随视角和表情的变化而演变，从而导致面部变形、姿态锁定、身份漂移或面部过度平滑。我们观察到，一段简短的参考视频片段天然地比任何单张图像提供更丰富的时序和多视角身份线索，这启发了一种基于视频参考的建模方式。然而，这种更丰富的信号也带来了新的挑战：身份证据分布在许多帧之中，必须在有限的token预算下被提炼成一个紧凑而稳定的表示。为此，我们提出了Slot-ID，一个构建在冻结的文本到视频骨干之上的轻量级身份条件化框架。Slot-ID采用基于槽位的时序身份编……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出Slot-ID框架，通过基于槽位的时序身份编码，将参考视频中分布多帧的身份线索提炼为紧凑稳定的表示，在冻结的文本到视频骨干上实现大视角、表情、光照和运动变化下的身份保持视频生成。
en_tdlr: Slot-ID introduces a slot-based temporal identity encoding that distills identity cues distributed across reference video frames into a compact, stable representation, enabling identity-preserving text-to-video generation on a frozen backbone under large changes in viewpoint, expression, illumination, and motion.
